5.5.1 Branch Breaker ( Plug On Thermal Magnetic Type IC 5 kA)

warnings: PNG contains TWO portrait BOQ sheets laid out side by side in one landscape scan, per spec §11. Rotate the PNG 90 degrees counter-clockwise to read. The physical RIGHT half is the LOWER-numbered sheet and is written to _1.json; the physical LEFT half is _2.json.

EVERY PRICE COLUMN IS BLANK ON EVERY ROW OF THE WHOLE BOQ -- ราคาหน่วยละ, จำนวนเงิน (material and labour), and รวมค่าวัสดุและค่าแรงงาน. This is a แบบ ปร.4 QUANTITY schedule issued unpriced by กองมาตรฐานราคากลาง for the estimator to fill in. Nulls are transcribed, never invented.

The title block is identical on every sheet of the set: form แบบ ปร.4, drawing numbers S-62047 / AR-61142 / SN-62034 / EE-62062 / M-62028, สถานที่ก่อสร้าง ทั่วไป, unit บาท, with ประมาณการโดย and ประมาณราคาเมื่อวันที่ left blank.

*** THIS SHEET CLOSES THE 'BY ME' LOOP COMPLETELY. *** EE-02 showed five air-conditioning ways with no breaker rating and no cable size, bracketed 'BY ME'. Here they are, priced in the MECHANICAL category: 2 x Branch CB 20AT-1P and 3 x Branch CB 25AT-1P -- five breakers, and the split matches M-01's schedule exactly (20 AT for the two 18,000 BTU/Hr units, 25 AT for the three 24,000 BTU/Hr units).

*** THE BREAKING CAPACITY DISAGREES BETWEEN DISCIPLINES: this sheet says IC 5 kA, while every electrical breaker on แผ่นที่ 23/34 and EE-02 is IC 6 kA. *** Same board, two different ratings specified by two different engineers. Recorded as printed; not reconciled by either document.
The cable split also matches M-01: 4 sq.mm for the 24,000 BTU/Hr units and 2.5 sq.mm for the 18,000 units, plus the G-2.5 earth throughout. 323 m of 2.5 and 70 m of 4 sq.mm.

*** THE CONDUIT IS EMT AND IMC -- STEEL -- WHERE THE WHOLE ELECTRICAL CATEGORY USES PVC. *** M-01's fan note and M-04's wiring diagram both specify ø1/2" EMT, so the BOQ follows the mechanical drawings faithfully; the two disciplines simply specify different conduit for work that meets at the same consumer unit. IMC (25 m) appears here and in no drawing at all -- it is the heavier-wall steel conduit, presumably for the exposed outdoor runs to the condensing units.

*** THE SAFETY SWITCHES ARE PRICED -- ON THE NEXT SHEET (แผ่นที่ 33/34), NOT HERE. *** 2 x 20A-2P and 3 x 25A-2P disconnecting switches, matching M-04's requirement of one weatherproof disconnect per condensing unit exactly. The category subtotal (รวมข้อ 5.5) is on that sheet, confirming this one is a continuation, not a complete category.
The sheet has no รวมข้อ 5.5 subtotal row; the category total appears on the next sheet.
